summary: NeuroOne Medical Technologies filed an 8-K on August 27, 2026, announcing successful large-animal procedures using its StereoCED platform for robotic-assisted drug delivery. The press release highlights two procedures combining drug delivery and intracranial electrophysiological recording, a first in convection-enhanced delivery. The company expects revenue recognition in the current fiscal quarter and plans human studies later in the quarter. This is a routine operational progress update, not a special situation. No deal terms, capital structure changes, or strategic actions are disclosed. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, tender, or other transaction-related information.
